content.rendered:
Sherwood School District has partnered with ESS to manage our substitute program. A leader in K-12 staffing, ESS is now responsible for the hiring, training, and placement of licensed substitute teachers, school aides, custodians, food service workers, and more! If you’re interested in working as a substitute for our district, please visit ESS.com to apply or call 866.208.7454 for more information.

Substitute Bus Drivers

Substitute Bus Drivers are the only substitutes Sherwood School District hires directly. If you are interested in applying to be a substitute bus driver please visit our employment page for more information and apply directly.
